title: DOOR-WATERPROOF PAPER & TRIM PANEL
summary: Door (all models) waterproof liner (the water shield / vapor barrier behind the door panel) and the interior door trim panel with its pull handle. The liner is stuck to the door inner panel with a sealer bead; the trim panel is screwed on through washers along its top and lower area, and clips engage slots in the door inner panel at the bottom. Trim panel and pull handle part numbers vary with trim and are listed on a chart.

parts.name: TRIM PANEL ASM. CHART
parts.name_expanded: Door trim panel assembly (see trim chart)

parts.name: PULL HANDLE ASM. CHART
parts.name_expanded: Door pull handle assembly (see trim chart)

materials.where: continuous bead around the edge of the door inner panel, under the liner [1]

fastening.note: Liner [1] is laid onto a bead of sealer 69b running around the inner panel edge. Rear edge of the bead at least 2.0 in. from the rear edge of the inner panel, door lock to bottom of door (NOTE).

Screws [4] go through washers [3] and the upper part of the trim panel [2]: one pair at the front/middle of the panel top, one pair at the rear upper corner. Washer locations [3] are also marked on the inner panel.
Two screws [6] go through the trim panel [2] near and below the pull handle [7].

fastening.to: slots along the bottom of the door inner panel
fastening.note: Clips [5] sit on the lower edge of the trim panel and in the slots at the bottom of the inner panel. View A: clip [5] at a SLOT with screw [9] beside it.

notes: Rear edge of sealer bead must be 2.0" minimum from rear edge of inner door panel from door lock to bottom of door.
Locate 1.46 dia. hole & 3 slots in vinyl & foam at existing hole & slots in form board at asm.
